title: Leaks in messaging: SpeakRequest, KeyPackageRequest, broadcast
description: From phase B (04-messaging): SpeakRequest (§6.1.2) in clear exposes requesterDID+channelCID; KeyPackageRequest on discovery topic exposes requestedBy/targetDID (social graph, ties Q3 agora-pozi.10); broadcast channels (§6.1.4) have no MLS group so channelToken/access proof undefined and senderDID visible. nie agoraold-sy6s used a relay-generated secret for broadcast — rejected (violates S3).
close_reason: Fixed in P1 pass 2026-10-16 (uncommitted at close; see next commit)
